title: AI Automation Engineer for Support, Knowledge Base and Workflow Automation
description:
About Us
We are an online brand selling technical products that customers can configure in many ways. This creates a lot of detailed questions for our team, so we want to bring in an AI Automation Engineer to help us organise and automate our main workflows.

What We Want to Achieve
- Support: Cut down the time our team spends on emails and help them answer detailed product questions faster. We use a helpdesk tool today, but we are open to changing the setup if there is a better option.
- Knowledge base and training: Collect our product knowledge and company policies in one AI-powered knowledge base, and use it to create training material for new virtual assistants.
- Ongoing improvements: Later on, automate other slow areas of the business, such as inventory planning, and improve our website so fewer customers need to contact support.

Requirements
- Experience building and launching AI agents, RAG knowledge bases and workflow automations for real businesses.
- Able to review how we work today and suggest a simple, reliable setup that our team can use every day without much upkeep.
- Hands-on experience with LLM APIs such as OpenAI and Claude, and with connecting AI to business tools and CRMs.
